slug: 2025-12-11 South Sudan to get data protection bill in 2026, says minister

facts.fact: ICT Minister Ateny Wek Ateny said the government will introduce its first-ever Data Protection Bill in 2026, to be drafted jointly by the ministries of information and justice.
The minister announced on 2025-12-11 (article date; event reported as the previous Thursday) that a Data Protection Bill would be introduced in 2026.
